releases.notes:
SkyDash brings your Hypixel SkyBlock progress together in one customizable in-game dashboard.

## Updated profile connection

SkyDash no longer accepts Hypixel API keys from players. Existing saved key fields are discarded when configuration is saved. Profile snapshots are requested through the SkyDash service on dashboard opening or Refresh; they are not polled in the background. XP rates use local game observations.

**The SkyDash service is not deployed yet.** Profile-based Garden, skill progress, Museum, collections and personal Bingo views show as unavailable until the service is available. Bazaar tools, news, timers, item lookup, local session statistics, inventory estimates and HUD customization remain available.

## Requirements

- Minecraft **26.1.2** and Java **25**
- Fabric Loader **0.20.1+**
- Fabric API **0.155.3+26.1.2**
- Optional: Mod Menu **18.0.2**

Replace the previous SkyDash JAR with **skydash-0.1.1.jar** in your Minecraft `mods` folder. Join Hypixel SkyBlock and press **O** to open the dashboard. See the [README](https://github.com/edshaib/SkyDash#readme) for details.

This is a prerelease. Market values and countdowns are estimates. SkyDash is independent and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Hypixel.
